groups.name: Rounded cards with soft shadows
groups.definition: Do cards or panels combine rounded corners with soft drop shadows for depth?

groups.name: Flat look without shadows or gradients
groups.definition: Does the page look flat, with no or almost no box shadows, gradients, or backdrop blur?

groups.name: Restrained visual effects overall
groups.definition: Are visual effects (shadows, transitions, transforms) minimal across the page?

groups.name: Hover transitions on interactive elements
groups.definition: Do interactive elements define CSS transitions?

groups.name: Gradient hero background
groups.definition: Does the hero section use a CSS gradient background rather than a photo?

groups.name: Large or medium rounded corners widely used
groups.definition: Are medium-to-large corner radii (about 8px or more) used widely across cards, buttons and images?

groups.name: Small or square corner radii
groups.definition: Are corners square or only slightly rounded, with no large radii?

groups.name: Soft large-blur image shadows
groups.definition: Do feature images carry soft, large-blur drop shadows?

groups.name: Offset lip edges and tilted elements
groups.definition: Do cards and photos use solid offset edges and tilted shadowed elements instead of soft effects?

groups.name: No brush-stroke section dividers
groups.definition: Are section edges free of brush-stroke or torn-paint dividers?

groups.name: Plain text rows with divider rules
groups.definition: Are lists plain text rows separated by thin divider rules without icons?

groups.name: Decorative star-glyph italic label strip
groups.definition: Is there a strip of italic serif labels with decorative star bullets below the hero?

groups.name: Sections separated by tone and rules
groups.definition: Are sections separated by alternating dark tones and thin horizontal rules?

groups.name: Short accent underline under headings
groups.definition: Do section headings have a short colored accent underline bar?

groups.name: White bordered cards on off-white background
groups.definition: Do content cards and plates sit as white, bordered, rounded boxes on an off-white or tinted page background?

groups.name: Colored left-border accent on cards
groups.definition: Do cards carry a thick accent-colored left border?

groups.name: Decorative marker on card headings
groups.definition: Are card headings marked with a small green square or decorative icon image?

groups.name: Diagonal wedge section divider
groups.definition: Does the hero end with a full-width diagonal wedge divider?

groups.name: Footer disclaimer below thin divider
groups.definition: Do legal disclaimer and copyright sit below a thin divider in small light text?

groups.name: Sticky header with backdrop blur
groups.definition: Does the header use a semi-transparent background with backdrop blur?

groups.name: Hero background is a soft peach-to-cream gradient.
groups.definition: Hero background is a soft peach-to-cream gradient.
